name: System Pulse
author: Coding-Sparrow
description: Live CPU, memory, GPU, network and battery readings in the bar, iStat-style.

barWidget.description: Live CPU, memory, GPU, network and battery readings in the bar, iStat-style.

schema.label: Show CPU
schema.description: CPU percent in the bar label and history sparkline.

schema.label: Show memory
schema.description: Memory percent in the bar label and history sparkline.

schema.label: Show network
schema.description: Download/upload speeds in the bar label and history sparkline.

schema.label: Show battery
schema.description: Battery percent in the bar label. Hidden automatically when there is no battery.

schema.label: Show disk
schema.description: Hottest filesystem percent in the bar label.

schema.label: Show GPU
schema.description: GPU busy percent in the bar, when the kernel exposes gpu_busy_percent (AMD/some NVIDIA).

schema.label: Compact bar
schema.description: Drop CPU/MEM/BAT prefixes so the widget stays narrow.

schema.label: Ping check
schema.description: Periodically ping to detect packet loss. Off by default so the widget never phones home.

schema.label: Battery alert below (%)
schema.description: Turn the battery segment urgent while discharging below this percent.

schema.label: CPU temp alert above (°C)
schema.description: Turn the CPU segment urgent when package temperature exceeds this.

schema.label: Disk alert above (%)
schema.description: Turn urgent when the root filesystem is this full.

schema.label: Memory alert above (%)
schema.description: Turn the memory segment urgent when used memory exceeds this percent.

schema.label: Desktop notifications on alerts
schema.description: Fire a desktop notification once as each alert triggers. Clicking it opens the panel.

schema.label: Connectivity check interval (ms)
schema.description: Only used when Ping check is on.

schema.label: Failed pings before network alert
schema.description: Consecutive failed probes before the network segment turns red. Only used when Ping check is on.
